description: This file defines the BuilderList class, which manages a collection of builder bots used for running layout tests. It includes methods to retrieve builder names, port names, specifiers, and to find builders based on various criteria.

classes.name: BuilderList
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of builder bots, providing methods to access builder information and perform lookups based on builder names, port names, and specifiers.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BuilderList with a dictionary mapping builder names to their properties.

methods.name: all_builder_names
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all builder names.

methods.name: all_try_builder_names
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of builder names that are try builders.

methods.name: all_continuous_builder_names
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of builder names that are not try builders.

methods.name: all_port_names
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all port names used by the builders.

methods.name: port_name_for_builder_name
methods.description: Returns the port name associated with a given builder name.

methods.name: specifiers_for_builder
methods.description: Returns the list of specifiers for a given builder name.

methods.name: builder_name_for_port_name
methods.description: Finds a builder name for a given port name, preferring non-debug, non-try builders.

methods.name: version_specifier_for_port_name
methods.description: Returns the OS version specifier for a given port name.

methods.name: builder_name_for_specifiers
methods.description: Finds a builder name matching a specific OS version and build type.
